Deq shapes as typed, tree-shakable Svelte 5 components.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RojHalfSun, DeqIcon } from "@0xdolan/deq-svelte";
</script>
<RojHalfSun size={32} strokeWidth={1.5} absoluteStrokeWidth />
<DeqIcon name="kurdish-sun" color="#ED2024" />
```

Source: [`packages/svelte`](../../packages/svelte/). Install with `npm install @0xdolan/deq-svelte`.

## Per-shape exports

93 generated exports, one per shape, such as `ArchDot`, `ArchDotColumn`, `ArrowDown`. The [icon list](https://kanilabs.github.io/deq/icons/) shows every shape.

## Constants

### `DeqIcon`

```ts
const DeqIcon: LegacyComponentType
```

Draws any catalog shape by id (`name`); props are `DeqIconByNameProps`.

### `Icon`

```ts
const Icon: LegacyComponentType
```

Draws icon data from `@0xdolan/deq-icons` (`icon`); props are `IconProps`.

### `packageName`

```ts
const packageName: '@0xdolan/deq-svelte'
```

The npm package name.

## Interfaces

### `DeqIconByNameProps`

```ts
interface DeqIconByNameProps
```

Props of `DeqIcon`: a catalog id plus the usual props.

- `name: string`: Catalog id, for example `roj-half-sun`.
- `children?: Snippet<[]>`: Added inside the `<svg>`, after the shape.
- `size?: string | number`: Width and height in px, or any CSS length. Default 24.
- `color?: string`: Stroke and dot colour (CSS colour). Default `currentColor`.
- `strokeWidth?: string | number`: Stroke width in grid units. Default 2.
- `absoluteStrokeWidth?: boolean`: Keep the stroke `strokeWidth` px wide at any numeric `size`. Default false.
- `title?: string`: Accessible title. Default: the English name. `""` marks the icon decorative.

### `DeqIconProps`

```ts
interface DeqIconProps
```

Props of every Deq icon component; other SVG attributes pass through to the `<svg>`.

- `children?: Snippet<[]>`: Added inside the `<svg>`, after the shape.
- `size?: string | number`: Width and height in px, or any CSS length. Default 24.
- `color?: string`: Stroke and dot colour (CSS colour). Default `currentColor`.
- `strokeWidth?: string | number`: Stroke width in grid units. Default 2.
- `absoluteStrokeWidth?: boolean`: Keep the stroke `strokeWidth` px wide at any numeric `size`. Default false.
- `title?: string`: Accessible title. Default: the English name. `""` marks the icon decorative.

### `IconProps`

```ts
interface IconProps
```

Props of `Icon`: icon data plus the usual props.

- `icon: DeqIcon`: The icon data, for example `rojHalfSun` from `@0xdolan/deq-icons`.
- `children?: Snippet<[]>`: Added inside the `<svg>`, after the shape.
- `size?: string | number`: Width and height in px, or any CSS length. Default 24.
- `color?: string`: Stroke and dot colour (CSS colour). Default `currentColor`.
- `strokeWidth?: string | number`: Stroke width in grid units. Default 2.
- `absoluteStrokeWidth?: boolean`: Keep the stroke `strokeWidth` px wide at any numeric `size`. Default false.
- `title?: string`: Accessible title. Default: the English name. `""` marks the icon decorative.
